propositions: The T10 rubric must partition routine durable-infrastructure checks away from transient throwaway experiments while retaining all four MAJOR safety classes

The scope clause must be immediately followed by a safety qualifier stating that destructive transient apply, wildcard-admin, plaintext-secret, and untrusted-network endpoint-auth protections remain in scope

The packaged eval spec must contain exactly ten balanced dataset cases: five pass controls (throwaway loopback probe with teardown, fully specified durable infra, private-network transient with scoped IAM, transient retrieving secret from manager, sandboxed transient with safe teardown) and five finding controls (under-specified durable lifecycle, destructive transient apply, transient wildcard-admin, transient plaintext secret, untrusted-network transient service)
Offline text-contract tests must lock the exact scope clause, exact co-located safety qualifier, and rubric independence by rejecting any T15 reference
The T10 rubric must remain independent without naming T15 or delegating scope to another overlay
